claims.text: The source defines DreamBooth personalisation: finetune all layers of a frozen pretrained diffusion model on 3-5 images captioned with a rare-token identifier plus class noun, with autogenous class prior-preservation loss (own class samples, weight lambda); inference reuses the frozen personalised model with identifier prompts for recontextualisation, view synthesis, art rendition, property modification.

Reported numbers: 30 subjects x 25 prompts x 4 images (3000 images): Imagen-DreamBooth DINO 0.696 / CLIP-I 0.812 / CLIP-T 0.306, SD-DreamBooth 0.668/0.803/0.305 vs Textual-Inversion 0.569/0.780/0.255; user study (72 users, 1800 answers) SD-DreamBooth over TI: subject 68% vs 22%, prompt 81% vs 12%; ~1000 iterations, lambda 1.
